intro: After Hand of Iruxos, Taiga Wisemane in Shadowprey Village shows you the Hand and asks you to banish six demon portals at Mannoroc Coven, warning you to be wary of the portal guardians.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Behold - the Hand of Iruxos. A gruesome sight indeed.

You must possess it if the demon portals at Mannoroc Coven are to be banished... Which is what I now ask you to do. The Demon threat is increasing and we must close these portals to stem the tide of demons to this world. Good luck, friend... And be wary of the portal guardians.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you banished the demon portals at Mannoroc Coven?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You are to be commended, friend. Your effort has helped greatly in fighting the demon threat, and all of Azeroth is safer because of it.
